verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for any service that holds personal data, including an immigration agency, so the axis applies. The only related evidence covers seeing the personal information UKVI holds, which is an access right, not user control over how long data is kept or deleting it. No evidence shows any retention or deletion control, so this adjacent evidence earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
